name: Joodrudda
description: Joodrudda was a barren, nearly uninhabited world located on the Tingel Route, just outside the borders of the Corporate Sector. Its only point of interest was a sprawling palace constructed hundreds of years before the Battle of Yavin by a clan of eccentric Hutts.
